column2: Okay, hold still for just a second . . .
Hello there, my fine furry friend!
Well, I have a modest request.
GIVE ME BACK MY DRAM BINOCULARS!!
OK, you took something that wasn't yours . . .
May I have my binoculars back, please?
Give them to me now, you obnoxious inbred!!!
That lousy monkey took my binoculars!
LOG OFF.  I'm gonna show him a thing or two!
LOG OFF.  They must not like men too much!
No, why don't you just keep that.

Great. Another transmorph.	
176	~I need a REAL man.
WHAT!?! I said I needed a REAL man.
(Could we just go to bed immediately, please?)

Oh, like you weren't a woman ten minutes ago.	
186	~How's it feel to have your gender bent, Keeper?
Bent? Keeper? What are you talking about?
Lady, I'm shipwrecked here.  Seen a vase anywhere?
Lady, you've got a screw loose.  Later.

Your Gender Bender is a curse.	
191	~You Keepers should be getting us some REAL men,	
192	~not playing with silly machines.
But I am a REAL man!
I'm really confused.  What's a Gender Bender?
That's nice.  Can I run my fingers through your hair?
Ok, sure, I'll get right on it.
Go stick it in a seashell.
Go stick it in the sand.

You know, that silly machine you Keepers use	
203	~to pretend you're men.  I think it's sick.
I'm not from around here -- and I'm not a 'Keeper'.
Let's pretend we're Adam and Eve!
Can we talk about this inside?
I'm going to have to think this over.  Bye.

Yeah?  Well you look like a Keeper to me.	
209	~How could you be a REAL man?	
210	~There aren't any left on the whole planet!
I'm not from this planet; I'm shipwrecked here.
I'm not a real man; I'm a quiche-eater.  Sorry.

You're going to have to prove that!	
215	~So, what's a torque wrench?
An old pirate's term for a stubborn woman.
A wrench for tightening baby-delivering birds.
A device for measuring the angular force applied to a bolt.
A tool for opening wine bottles.
Um, I'll have to get back to you on that.  Bye.

Lucky guess.  O.K., time for a hard one:	
222	~When setting a table, where do the forks go?
Wherever they land when I throw them from the kitchen.
Um, I'll have to get back to you on that.  Bye.

WOW! A REAL MAN!!!	
229	~You said your name was Rex?	
230	~Come here, Rex.  Let me show you my hut.
Hey, this is a neat hut.
I have something to show you, Rex.
That's right, scum! Make like a banana and split!
Can't do that any more; I'm empty.
Let's see if I can get this grate open.
If I go out there, those guards will see me!
Uh oh.  I think this is broken.
I think I'll leave this arm here . . .
